DESCRIPTION:
Show design structure: low-cohesion types (LCOM4), coupling hotspots, type cycles, feature envy, project instability

USAGE:
    assay structure [solution] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [solution]    Path to a .sln/.slnx file (auto-detected if omitted)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                                                                 
        --json                  Output as JSON instead of structured markdown                                           
        --no-cache              Force re-analysis of everything: --no-graph-cache, --no-coverage-cache and              
                                --no-coverage-import together                                                           
        --no-graph-cache        Bypass the graph cache only: re-run Roslyn analysis, keep reusing cached coverage and   
                                existing reports                                                                        
        --no-coverage-cache     Ignore cached coverage runs only (a collecting command re-runs 'dotnet test'; cached    
                                failures are retried)                                                                   
        --no-coverage-import    Do not import Cobertura reports an earlier 'dotnet test' left on disk; cached runs are  
                                still reused                                                                            
        --verbose               Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr                                           
        --lightweight           Use structural-only analysis (fast, no Roslyn)                                          
        --top <N>               Top N entries per list (default: 10)

                          orphan rule                                                                                   
        --keep-orphans    Keep graph caches whose solution no longer exists at any recorded checkout; prune by age alone
        --dry-run         List what would be removed, with the reason per entry, and delete nothing (also the default   
                          without --yes)                                                                                
        --yes             Actually delete the selected entries (without it, only the selection is printed)
